name: Minami-Echizen (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minami-Echizen town emblem in blue, green and orange: a blue stylised wave above a green stroke and an orange arc.
history: Municipal flag of Minami-Echizen, a town in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2005.

features.role: Minami-Echizen town emblem — a blue stylised wave above a green stroke and an orange arc
